text:
10. 1. 12

Gandhagandha suttaṃ

449. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti. 

Idha bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati, vācāya sucaritaṃ carati, manasā sucaritaṃ carati, tassa sutaṃ hoti "gandhagandhe adhivatthā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā"ti. Tassa evaṃ hoti: "aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ uppajjeyya"nti. so dātā hoti gandhagandhānaṃ. So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati. 

Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā gandhagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ uppajjatīti.
